testCase.name: [dev] S03 Card field × context: every required field present, diagnosis only on Hospital

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B23 · P1 · 已知

病人卡片缺字段：年龄是「76y」不是「76F」，医院卡片没有住院天数，养老院卡片没有访视次数

票：TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S05, TC-01/S06, TC-01/S26

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S03 「卡片字段 × 模式：每个必需的字段都在，诊断只在医院」 Card field × context: every required field present, diagnosis only on Hospital

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U2 The card shows the chief diagnosis on Hospital cards only; a Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3；UAT TC-03）
  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-01；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given seededCensus; H1 and N1 are checked here, with H2 and N2 (same last names) on the same lists

When Search each list for the patient's full name so only that card is shown, and snapshot it; NH on both Today's Visits and All Residents

Then Hospital card: name, room, diagnosis, '76F'-style age/sex, badge, hospital day. NH card: name, unit/room, age/sex, badge, visit number, and no diagnosis even though one is stored

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Decision table (field rows × context columns: required / absent) from UAT TC-01, TC-03 and AC 3. oracle.mjs per checkpoint: the list marker 'Open chart for <name>', the expected values, and no 'pre-round notes' (chart only). 'Day 3' and 'Visit 1' assume Q2/Q3 defaults; '87F' and 'Visit 1' cells may move with Q4. Card ownership of a value is judged in S26 (card-scoped), not here

在哪跑：dev 单元 U27；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa；TFA-92581 ready for qa

病人卡片上的年龄显示成「76y」，没有性别（应该是「76F」），也没有住院天数或访视次数；养老院卡片还显示了诊断。

Patient cards show age as '76y' with no sex instead of '76F' and show no hospital day or visit number, and the Nursing Home card also shows the diagnosis.

依据：dev U27 (ledger #27). Already in dev report §2 #5 (C2: age/sex, day/visit number; TFA-92579 AC 3–4) and §2 #4 (C1: NH diagnosis). The sex part depends on TC-01 Q1: the app has no way to enter sex. The local datasets lane failed on the same cells.

并进来的：本地 datasets TC-01/S03 (same failure, folded into this result)

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
